'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Greg Shaw DS Separatist Uprising''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Separatist Uprising / At War With Itself|VB9-D-separatistuprising-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' stealtheblind
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
